description: A same-host stylesheet URL redirects (302) to the CDN, which answers 404: critical silently drops it.

thin.note: Proposal: the host that failed is the one that counts, i.e. the host of the LAST URL requested after redirects (the CDN here), so the failure is skipped with a warning. If the host written in the page counted instead (the page host), this would fail the job. Confirm before asserting. (In these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port: "same host" must compare host:port, as the url() rebasing does, or be injectable.)
